resolution: Ran npx fallow inside cart/hmsc-int and reconciled its dead-code report against the structure review. Of 140 flagged 'unused files', ~85 are P4 test suites (harness-run, false positives), 28 are alive via entry points fallow cannot model (gameShell.tsx is the rjit pack cartEntry with a whole pre-fold gameplay island behind it; compile/main+bake*+packPackage are rjit game/pack CLI entries; labs/_scaffold.tsx is the rjit-lab-new template; hostPhysics via zig bindings), and 22 were dead from EVERY entry point — deleted in 03da19d9c with docs+index updated in the same commit: the whole npc/ dir (superseded by the game/kinds capture), 3 orphaned lab scenes, the unwired worldFile/assets/assetPrompt lane, the tileField.wgsl shim (test repointed), heightField.wgsl, NpcFigure/driveInScreen pair, and stragglers. Verified: cart bundle green on BOTH entries, roadData 26/26, kinds suites 32/32. Fallow also independently confirms §13 (props.ts↔propKinds.ts is the #1 clone, 709 lines) and surfaced a NEW same-disease dup: game/kinds/landforms.ts↔world/landforms/registry.ts (103 lines). WORLDWIN pop-out confirmed rendering correctly by user (closes handoff item 0). OPEN: the gameShell/rjit-pack island — user says he never used the command; demolition candidate awaiting a ruling.
